resources.string: Designed to improve coordination, strengthen often-overlooked muscle groups, and boost cardiovascular endurance, this hybrid session lets you switch directions mid-workout.
Stay facing forward—the belt will start moving in reverse, causing you to walk forward.
Stay facing forward—the belt will start moving in reverse, causing you to walk backward.
Stay facing forward - the belt is stopping and will begin reversing shortly.

Designed to improve coordination, strengthen often-overlooked muscle groups, and boost cardiovascular endurance, this hybrid session lets you switch directions mid-workout. Alternate between walking forward to target glutes and hamstrings, and backward to engage quads, calves, and improve knee stability.
Speed and incline are fixed when workout begins. You may adjust the metrics after your workout starts.
